goal: Make the side panel's Use popup instead icon close the side panel and open the popup, and let people save everyone already invited to an artifact who isn't in any of their lists into a new or existing list, straight from People with access.

features.description: In the side panel, Use popup instead closes the side panel and opens the popup straight away, with my work as I left it
steps: In `npm run dev:fake`, click the header's Open in side panel icon: the popup closes and ArtiShare opens in the side panel
In the side panel, add https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleArtifactOne01, tick a list, and switch to the Lists tab
Click the header's Use popup instead icon (a window with a bar across its top): the side panel closes and the ArtiShare popup opens under the toolbar icon by itself, without clicking the toolbar icon
In the popup see the Lists tab, the artifact and the ticked list exactly as they were in the side panel
Click away so the popup closes, then click the ArtiShare toolbar icon: the popup opens again (not the side panel)

In e2e (sidepanel.html opened as a page): clicking Use popup instead calls `chrome.action.openPopup` after `chrome.action.getPopup` already returns the popup page and `getPanelBehavior` says openPanelOnActionClick is false, and the side panel page closes

features.description: If Chrome can't open the popup from the side panel, the side panel stays open and tells me to click the toolbar icon, instead of just vanishing
steps: Open ArtiShare in the side panel. In e2e, make `chrome.action.openPopup` reject with 'Could not find an active browser window.' and click Use popup instead: the side panel stays open and shows 'Switched to the popup, but Chrome couldn't open it: Could not find an active browser window. Click the ArtiShare icon in the toolbar to open it.'
Check that the switch still happened: `chrome.action.getPopup` returns the popup page, the stored choice is popup, and the next toolbar click opens the popup

In e2e, make `chrome.action.openPopup` undefined (a Chrome older than 127) and click Use popup instead: the side panel stays open and shows 'Switched to the popup. Click the ArtiShare icon in the toolbar to open it.' (no 'couldn't open it' part)
While that message shows, the Use popup instead icon reads Open popup and clicking it tries `openPopup` again; when that succeeds the side panel closes

If saving the choice itself fails (storage rejects), the side panel stays open with the existing 'Couldn't switch to the popup: …' message and nothing is changed: `getPopup` still returns '' and the toolbar icon still opens the side panel

features.description: Switching to the popup closes ArtiShare's side panel in every window and doesn't interrupt a run
steps: Open ArtiShare in the side panel of two browser windows (in e2e: two sidepanel.html pages)

Click Use popup instead in the first: the popup opens in the first window, and the second window's ArtiShare side panel closes too within a second, so no window is left with a side panel the toolbar icon no longer opens

Start a run in the side panel that sends to 6 addresses on one artifact, and click Use popup instead while it is sending: the popup opens showing the same run with live progress, and the run finishes with every address invited once

Click Open in side panel in the popup, then Use popup instead in the side panel, then Open in side panel again: each click moves ArtiShare to the other place, and the last choice is the one the toolbar icon opens

features.description: Teach the fake claude.ai an artifact with a long list of people already invited, so saving many people to a list can be tried
steps: Read the rules at the top of `src/claude/fakeShareClient.ts`: a new rule says an artifact id containing 'Crowded' starts with 45 people invited: crowd01@example.com … crowd45@example.com, odd numbers Pending with Can view, even numbers Accepted with Can comment

In `npm run dev:fake`, open https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleCrowdedArtifact1 (in e2e, served by a route) and click the header's Manage access icon: People with access lists You (owner), then the 45 people in that order
Open Manage access for an artifact id containing 'Shared': still the same three people as before (viewer@, commenter@, locked@example.com); one with neither word: still 'Only you have access.'
Unit tests cover the new rule, and every existing unit and e2e test still passes

features.description: People with access shows, for each person invited, which of my lists they're in, or 'Not in a list'
steps: Save a list 'Team' with viewer@example.com, and no list with commenter@example.com or locked@example.com

Open Manage access over https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleSharedArtifact1: viewer@example.com's row reads 'Accepted · In Team'; commenter@example.com's reads 'Pending · Not in a list'; locked@example.com's reads 'Accepted · Not in a list'; You (owner) has neither

Save viewer@example.com in a second list 'Reviewers' too: the row reads 'Accepted · In Team, Reviewers' (list names in the Lists tab's order); with more than two lists it reads 'In Team, Reviewers +1', with every name in a tooltip

Addresses are matched the way lists match them: a list holding Viewer@Example.com counts for viewer@example.com, and for Gmail a list holding janedoe@gmail.com counts for an invitee jane.doe+work@gmail.com (same inbox)

With People with access open in the side panel, save commenter@example.com into a list from the Lists tab of a popup in another window: within a second the side panel's row changes to 'Pending · In <that list>' without pressing Refresh

features.description: When some people with access aren't in any of my lists, People with access offers to save them to a list
steps: Open Manage access over a 'Shared' artifact with no saved lists: under the people, see '3 people aren't in any of your lists.' and a 'Save to a list' button
Save viewer@example.com and commenter@example.com in a list and reopen: it reads '1 person isn't in any of your lists.' (singular)
Save locked@example.com in a list too: the note and the button are gone
Open Manage access over an artifact nobody is invited to: 'Only you have access.' and no Save to a list
Open Manage access over an artifact id containing 'Missing': the error and Retry show, and no Save to a list
The note is a quiet line under the people, not a warning: no red, no alert role

features.description: Save to a list puts the people who aren't in any list into a new list in a couple of clicks
steps: With no saved lists, open Manage access over a 'Shared' artifact and click Save to a list: People with access is replaced in place by 'Save to a list', with Back still at the top, and focus moves to its heading

See every person who isn't in a list as a ticked checkbox labelled with their address and their permission on this artifact (commenter@example.com · Can comment, locked@example.com · Can view, viewer@example.com · Can view), a 'Select all' checkbox that is ticked, and '3 of 3 selected'

With no saved lists, see only the new-list fields: Name, with the placeholder the Lists tab uses for an unnamed list ('commenter@example.com & locked@example.com +1 email'), and Permission, preset to the permission every ticked person has if they all have the same, otherwise Can view

Type 'Shared reviewers' as the name and click 'Save 3 people': back on People with access, see 'Saved 3 people to Shared reviewers.' with an 'Open list' link, every row now reads 'In Shared reviewers', and the note and Save to a list button are gone
Click Open list: the Lists tab opens with Shared reviewers open, holding the three addresses and the chosen permission; the Lists count went up by 1
Do it again on another artifact leaving the name empty: the list gets the placeholder name, made unique with ' (2)' if a list already has it, as the Lists tab does

features.description: Save to a list can instead add the people to one of my existing lists
steps: Save lists 'Team' (a@example.com, Can edit) and 'Design' (b@example.com, Can view). Open Manage access over a 'Shared' artifact and click Save to a list

See two choices, 'New list' (picked) and 'Add to an existing list'; pick Add to an existing list: a drop-down labelled List shows Team and Design in the Lists tab's order, with each list's address count, and the Name and Permission fields are hidden
Pick Team: see 'They'll get Team's permission (Can edit) when you share with Team. Their access to this artifact doesn't change.'
Click 'Add 3 people to Team': back on People with access, see 'Added 3 people to Team.' with Open list; every row reads 'In Team'
In the Lists tab, Team holds a@example.com first, then the three new addresses, still with Can edit; Design is unchanged and no list was created
With no saved lists, Add to an existing list isn't offered at all

features.description: In Save to a list I choose exactly who to save, and can back out without saving anything, by mouse or keyboard
steps: Open Save to a list over a 'Shared' artifact with no lists. Untick locked@example.com: '2 of 3 selected', Select all becomes mixed (indeterminate), the button reads 'Save 2 people', and the name placeholder follows the ticked addresses
Click Select all: all three are ticked; click it again: none are ticked, '0 of 3 selected', and the save button is disabled

Tick only commenter@example.com: the button reads 'Save 1 person'; save: only commenter@example.com is in the new list, and the other two still read 'Not in a list', with '2 people aren't in any of your lists.' and Save to a list still there

Open Save to a list and click Cancel: People with access is back as it was, nothing is saved, and focus returns to the Save to a list button. Back at the top returns to the tab Manage access was opened from, as it does from People with access

Do the whole flow with the keyboard only: Tab reaches each checkbox, Space ticks it, the choices, fields and the save button are reachable in order with a visible focus ring, and Enter in the Name field saves
Close the popup in the middle of choosing and reopen it: no list was created or changed

features.description: If Save to a list can't save, it says why and keeps what I chose
steps: Save a list 'Team'. In Save to a list choose New list, type 'team' and save: 'A list called "team" already exists.' shows by the Name field, nothing is saved, and the ticks, name and permission are kept

Pick Add to an existing list → Team, then delete Team from the Lists tab of another window and click Add: an error says the list changed or no longer exists, nothing is saved, the drop-down no longer offers Team, and you can pick another list or New list

Pick Team, then change Team in another window and click Add: the people are added to Team as it is now (its other changes are kept, not overwritten), or the error asks to try again; never a list with the other window's change lost
In e2e, make saving the lists fail (config-change rejects): the reason shows in Save to a list, nothing changes, and clicking save again retries
While the save is in progress the button reads 'Saving…' and is disabled, so a double click saves once

features.description: Save to a list copes with a long list of people and with things changing while it's open
steps: Open Manage access over https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleCrowdedArtifact1 in the popup: '45 people aren't in any of your lists.'; open Save to a list: 45 checkboxes in the order People with access shows them, '45 of 45 selected'

Scroll the checkboxes: the popup's header stays put, nothing scrolls sideways, and the save button stays reachable without scrolling back to the top (it sits below the checkboxes in a bar that stays visible)
Click 'Save 45 people' with the name 'Crowd': one list Crowd holds all 45 addresses; People with access shows all 45 as 'In Crowd'
Do the same in the side panel at 320 px wide: the same, with long addresses cut off with … and the full address in a tooltip

With Save to a list open, save crowd01@example.com into a list from another window: within a second it drops out of the checkboxes and the count reads '… of 44 selected'; if that leaves nobody, Save to a list closes and People with access shows no note

With Save to a list open, a run that invites new people to this artifact finishes: the checkboxes don't change by themselves; after Cancel, Refresh on People with access shows the new people with 'Not in a list' and the count includes them
People shown by claude.ai without an invitation id (who joined the organization) can be saved like everyone else; You (owner) is never offered

features.description: The docs describe Use popup instead opening the popup, and saving people with access to a list
steps: README, Side panel paragraph: Use popup instead closes the side panel and opens the popup straight away, closes the side panel in other windows too, and what happens when Chrome can't open the popup (click the toolbar icon)

README, Manage access section: each person shows the lists they're in or 'Not in a list', and Save to a list saves the people who aren't in any list to a new list or an existing one, choosing who with checkboxes; their access to the artifact doesn't change
store/listing.md and docs/index.html, wherever they describe the side panel or Manage access, say the same; nothing anywhere says Use popup instead only switches the toolbar icon
The README's Limits table and the rest are unchanged; an e2e spec reads the files and checks the wording, as the side-panel-mode F017 spec does

features.description: The screenshots show Manage access with the lists each person is in and Save to a list
steps: Run `npm run screenshots`: docs/images/manage.png shows People with access over a 'Shared' artifact with one person 'In <a list>', two 'Not in a list', the note and the Save to a list button
A new docs/images/manage-save.png shows Save to a list with the checkboxes, New list picked and a name typed, and the README shows it beside manage.png with alt text describing it
The store images stay 1280×800, all addresses and ids in the pictures are made up (example.com, Example… artifact ids), and the screenshot e2e checks cover the new image
